# docneural — Org, Emacs, Guix manuals, wired as synapses

> The Org, Emacs, Guix reference manuals, split per Info node, exported
> by batch Emacs, and wired into an org-roam style citation graph.
> Every page is also raw Org, readable as-is by humans and LLM
> agents alike.
